items.title: 14.7 Greenhouse effect and global warming (zameen ka garam hona) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.7 with Figure 14.5, printed pages 313-314.

blocks.text: Global warming ka matlab hai human activities ki wajah se zameen ki surface ke average temperature ka lambe arse tak barhte jana; is ki bari wajah fossil fuels jalne se nikalne wali greenhouse gases (GHGs) hain.

blocks.title: Greenhouse effect
blocks.text: Atmosphere ki greenhouse gases blanket (kambal) ki tarah garmi rokti hain; is blanket jaise asar se zameen ki surface ka aahista aahista garam hote jana greenhouse effect kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Sooraj ke neeche zameen ka ek tukra jis par darakht, oonchi buildings aur chimniyon wali factory hai. Solid peele teer 'Sunlight' zameen tak aate hain; ek dashed teer 'Reflected sunlight' wapas oopar 'Energy released back into space' tak jata hai. Dashed teer zameen aur buildings se gases CH4, CO2, SF6 aur N2O tak uthte hain, jin par 'Greenhouse gases (trap heat)' likha hai, aur wapas neeche aate hain. Zameen par 'Energy absorbed' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.5: Global warming ka mechanism (kitab ki Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dhoop zameen tak aati hai aur zameen garam ho kar garmi (infrared) wapas oopar bhejti hai. Greenhouse gases is garmi ka kuch hissa rok kar wapas zameen ki taraf bhej deti hain, is liye zameen garam hoti jati hai. Kitab ki figure mein gases mein 'NO₂' chhapa hai; asal greenhouse gas N₂O (nitrous oxide) hai, is liye hamari drawing mein N₂O likha hai.

Yeh air pollution ka global level ka problem hai. Atmosphere ki carbon dioxide aur water vapour sooraj ki chhoti wavelength wali radiations ko guzarne dete hain, lekin garam zameen se aane wali lambi wavelength wali garmi ki radiations ko wapas mor dete hain.

Greenhouse effect gases ki infrared radiations absorb karne ki ability par based hai. Din mein sooraj ki garmi (infrared ki shakal mein) atmosphere se guzar kar zameen ko garam karti hai. Raat ko zameen garmi outer space (khala) ki taraf chhorti hai. Kuch gases yeh garmi rok leti hain aur use zaya (waste) hone nahi detin. Carbon dioxide aur doosri gases ki concentration jitni zyada hogi, garmi (thermal radiations) utni zyada absorb hogi aur zameen ka temperature utna hi zyada barhega.

blocks.prompt: a) Classical aur photochemical smog mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Classical (London) smog coal jalne se SO₂, kalikh aur dhund ka reducing mixture hai, jo thande, nami wale mausam mein banti hai. Photochemical (Los Angeles) smog tez dhoop mein traffic ke NOₓ aur VOCs ke reactions se banti hai; is ke bare hisse ozone aur PAN hain (oxidizing), aur yeh zyada khatarnak hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Greenhouse gases ke naam batayein. Yeh global warming kaise karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, water vapour aur CFCs. Yeh chhoti wavelength wali dhoop ko andar aane deti hain lekin zameen se nikalne wali lambi wavelength wali infrared garmi absorb kar ke wapas neeche bhejti hain; in gases jitni zyada, utni zyada garmi rukti hai aur average temperature barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Atmosphere ki sulphur trioxide se sulphuric acid banne ki balanced equation state symbols ke saath likhein.
blocks.explanation: SO₃(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₄(aq). (Kitab ke sawal mein sulphur trioxide ke saath ghalti se SO₂ likha hai; sulphur trioxide SO₃ hai.)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 14.3 (c) mein 'sulfur trioxide, SO₂' chhapa hai. Sulphur trioxide ka formula SO₃ hai; SO₂ sulphur dioxide hai.

items: Global warming: human GHGs se zameen ke average temperature ka lamba increase.
Greenhouse effect: CO₂ aur water vapour dhoop andar aane dete hain magar zameen ki infrared garmi rok lete hain; zyada GHGs, zyada garmi.
